description: Estimate the duty, VAT and total landed cost of an item shipped to the UK, US or EU from a tariff line. Use it for "what will import duty and VAT be on this?". Pass hs_code (a full tariff line, a candidate, not binding), destination (UK, US, EU), goods_value and shipping in one currency; optional origin, and country (member state) for EU VAT. UK and US duty rates are read from the official tariffs; EU duty is not looked up. Returns duty, VAT and total with the rate, basis, sources and date. A rate that is not a plain percentage is returned as text with no amount. US chapter 99 additional duties are not included.

country.description: EU member state for the VAT rate, such as DE (EU destination)

goods_value.description: Value of the goods, in the one currency used for every amount (no conversion is done)

hs_code.description: A full tariff line (UK 10 digits, US 8 or 10 digits), a candidate, not binding. EU rates are not looked up.

shipping.description: Shipping and insurance to the destination, in the same currency

name: landed_cost_estimate
title: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost
